# Jacobin

> Jacobin is a leading publication for left-wing political analysis, democratic socialism, and grassroots activism in the United States and globally.

Jacobin magazine combines investigative journalism, cultural criticism, and economic analysis to advance socialist politics and challenge mainstream narratives. The publication reaches readers through print issues, digital articles, a youth-focused Teen Jacobin section, and an online store featuring merchandise and back issues.

## Key Topics

- democratic socialism
- left-wing politics
- foreign policy
- Israel-Palestine
- Iran war
- economic inequality
- labor rights
- Palestinian solidarity
- political analysis
- free speech
- cultural criticism
- US imperialism
- social justice
- teenage culture
- grassroots activism

## Core Content

- [Jacobin Homepage](https://jacobin.com): Jacobin magazine homepage featuring left-wing politics and democratic socialism
- [Blog](https://jacobin.com/blog): Chronological archive of recent political and economic analysis articles
- [Teen Jacobin](https://jacobin.com/issue/teen-jacobin): Teen Jacobin issue featuring youth-focused leftist perspectives and Gen Z analysis

## Foreign Policy & International Analysis

- [A Simple Demand: No Aid to Israel](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/israel-palestine-us-aid-left): Left-wing foreign policy argument for cutting all US military and civilian aid to Israel
- [Europe Is Sanctioning Critics of Israel and Militarism](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/eu-us-sanctions-gaza-russia): Examination of EU sanctions used to suppress free speech on Israel-Palestine
- [The US Is Spending Billions to Bomb Iran](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/pentagon-iran-funding-usaid-cpb): Critique of $24 billion Pentagon spending on Iran war versus social programs
- [The Afghan-Pakistan War Is Spiraling Out of Control](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/afghanistan-pakistan-taliban-terrorism-ttp): Analysis of escalating military conflict between Pakistan and Taliban-ruled Afghanistan
- [Sectarianism Has Never Ended a War](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/sectarianism-antiwar-protests-vietnam-iran): Critique of left sectarianism in antiwar movements with Vietnam War lessons

## Economic & Social Justice

- [Budgeting Scolds Are Gaslighting Struggling Americans](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/poverty-financial-literacy-budgeting-welfare): Critique of financial literacy myths and advocacy for living wages and welfare
- [Match Week Is a Scam That Exploits Medical Residents](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/match-week-doctors-residents-unions): Exposé of medical residency matching system exploitation and labor rights issues

## Culture & Politics

- [Celebrities Can't Save Opera. Public Funding Can.](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/ballet-opera-chalamet-arts-funding): Analysis of arts funding crisis and need for public investment in opera and ballet
- [The Making of the Teenager](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/the-making-of-the-teenager): Historical analysis of teenage culture emergence in postwar America and New Deal
- [The Minecraft Marxists](https://jacobin.com/2026/03/the-minecraft-marxists): Political analysis of Marxist activism and protest within Minecraft gaming

## Publications & Store

- [Store](https://jacobin.com/store): Jacobin merchandise store selling branded products and socialist literature
